agenda_items.title: Service Broker Disambiguation — Embedded vs Remote Services Unified via ServiceDispatcher
agenda_items.intent_description: Resolve the architectural disconnect between embedded services (packaged with a broker, e.g., Spring beans) and remote services (external services called via REST). Redefine LOCAL to mean 'co-located with and directly owned by a specific broker runtime' rather than 'in-process.' Introduce ServiceDispatcher with multiple invokers: LocalInvoker (native language/framework dispatch) and Remote/HttpInvoker (network-mediated calls). This normalizes all brokers (Spring, Quarkus, Helidon, Go, Python) under a unified model where all brokers handle both LOCAL and REMOTE services as first-class citizens.
requirements: LOCAL redefined: co-located with and owned by broker runtime
ServiceDispatcher: unified dispatch across all brokers
All brokers handle LOCAL + REMOTE as first-class
Polyglot: Spring, Quarkus, Helidon, Go, Python unified model
